nodes.label: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
SBI VC Trade/BITPOINT combined platform accounts and deposits

hypotheses.claim: SBI has both direct recurring crypto-purchase rails and XRP reward-credit rails; together they create potential retail XRP acquisition/distribution, but actual XRP purchase volume remains unknown.
supporting: SBI VC Trade card allows XRP selection and monthly point conversion
Corporate/business-owner card adds employee cards
SBI VC Trade reports 2M registered accounts
START bond, shareholder and deposit reward programs add separate XRP-credit channels
SBI VC Trade officially offers automatic recurring crypto purchases including XRP
SBI's combined VCTRADE/BITPOINT platform reports 1.922M accounts and JPY 610B all-asset deposits as of March/April 2026
B2C2 market-maker connection is documented historically
disconfirming_or_alternative: No XRP selection share, monthly redemption volume or aggregate reward pool is disclosed
Point credits may be funded from existing inventory or issuer/partner inventory rather than new spot purchases
Registered accounts are not active XRP users
The 1.922M account and JPY 610B figures are all-asset platform scale, not XRP-specific active customers or deposits
B2C2 tenfold daily-volume increase is a historical company-reported all-asset metric, not current XRP depth
hypotheses.decision: Separate direct accumulation purchases from reward credits and platform custody; request/monitor XRP-specific purchase volumes and wallet flows before capital attribution.

hypotheses.claim: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail digital-asset strategy rather than an exclusive XRP strategy.
supporting: SBI Ripple Asia XRPL tokenized-deposit PoC
SBI VC Trade RLUSD product is Ethereum-only with XRPL planned
SBI Circle Japan JV and Arc validator role
JPYSC/Startale/Open Standard, Solana and conditional Bitbank activity
disconfirming_or_alternative: SBI's long-standing Ripple relationship and XRPL-specific projects may remain strategically important in selected corridors
hypotheses.decision: Model SBI as a multi-rail institutional group; avoid exclusive-XRP assumptions.

hypotheses.claim: Circle/ACI USDC settlement in Colombia may compete with or complement XRPL cross-border settlement.
supporting: USDC settlement is being demonstrated inside existing ACI/Bre-B infrastructure
ACI describes multi-rail support and future settlement models
disconfirming_or_alternative: No XRP integration, live volume or displaced XRPL corridor is disclosed
Multi-rail orchestration can allow several assets/providers to coexist
hypotheses.decision: Treat as a competing/complementary payments-rail scenario, not evidence of XRP displacement.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase's RLUSD partnership diversifies its stablecoin distribution beyond Circle USDC and may change stablecoin mix on Coinbase.
supporting: Direct Ripple-Coinbase RLUSD partnership
RLUSD availability on Prime, Exchange and Retail across XRPL/Base/Ethereum
1:1 conversion from USD and supported stablecoins
disconfirming_or_alternative: Coinbase-Circle distribution economics and USDC product balances remain material
No post-listing RLUSD/USDC balance, conversion or market-share data yet
hypotheses.decision: Monitor issuer-level balances, conversion flows, chain mix and collateral activation; do not claim USDC displacement.

hypotheses.claim: RLUSD support on XRPL can increase XRPL stablecoin activity without necessarily creating material XRP market demand.
supporting: RLUSD is supported on XRPL
Stablecoin transfers use XRPL transaction fees in native XRP
disconfirming_or_alternative: Greater RLUSD liquidity could indirectly improve XRPL utility and XRP routing, but no volume or market impact is measured
hypotheses.decision: Track RLUSD XRPL supply, transfer volume, DEX liquidity and XRP fee burn separately.

hypotheses.claim: The November 1 escrow eligibility event may result in a gross 1B XRP transfer, but actual net supply depends on EscrowFinish and subsequent re-escrow/disposition.
supporting: Two 500M objects have FinishAfter 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC
Historical 12-month pattern shows 8.4B of 12B released re-escrowed
disconfirming_or_alternative: No EscrowFinish transaction is guaranteed at eligibility
Funds may be re-escrowed or allocated rather than sold
hypotheses.decision: Measure eligible, finished, re-escrowed, transferred to exchanges and sold as separate states.

hypotheses.claim: Binance's current tracked-wallet balance does not prove that the 233.46M XRP theft was replenished.
supporting: XRP Insights same-wallet data reports Binance 2.78B and +17.6M over 7d
Other providers report different levels and address universes
disconfirming_or_alternative: Net aggregate change can mask large individual drains offset by inflows; per-wallet histories are absent
hypotheses.decision: Require per-wallet transaction history and official PoR liabilities before reserve-replenishment claims.

hypotheses.claim: XRP ETF flows are mixed and near-term flows are not a clean one-way capital signal.
supporting: Maketo reports Oct30 -$496.5K and 30-day +$19M
XRP Insights Oct30 row is provisional and Oct26-30 net +3.39M XRP
Alpha Oct29 reports +$8.4M
disconfirming_or_alternative: Provider coverage, settlement and flow definitions differ; cumulative inflows since 2025 remain positive
hypotheses.decision: Use fund-level settled holdings and creations/redemptions, not one aggregate headline.

hypotheses.claim: Current XRP derivatives positioning is long-skewed with positive funding, but aggregate OI is not yet reliable across providers.
supporting: TradRadar OI $1.86B and 78.5% long accounts
Alpha heatmap OI $2.81B and modelled leverage clusters
disconfirming_or_alternative: Different contract universes and notional conversions explain part of the discrepancy; account ratios are not notional exposure
hypotheses.decision: Keep provider-specific features and require contract-level normalization before aggregation.

hypotheses.claim: XRPL x402 activity demonstrates an agent-payment rail but currently has very small reported economic value relative to transaction counts.
supporting: XRPL AI Hub dashboard reports ~$45.2K value and 14.77M volume
T54 docs show payer-signed XRPL payments in XRP/RLUSD/USDC
xrpl.fi provides a reproducible fingerprint for recent transactions
disconfirming_or_alternative: Cumulative transaction count is not reconciled; independent scanner rejects the facilitator's cumulative claim as unaudited
hypotheses.decision: Track settled value by asset and validated transaction fingerprint; do not use raw count as capital demand.

hypotheses.claim: PR #1413 and PR #1414 improve V3 safety and prediction measurement if merged, but they do not currently change main.
supporting: Both exact-head CI runs and fail-closed gates passed
Both branches are based on current main and remain open/draft/unmerged
disconfirming_or_alternative: Main still contains the original writers, merge queue, deployment triggers and variable-horizon accuracy workflow
hypotheses.decision: Treat changes as designed/executed/verified on PR heads, not deployed or active.

hypotheses.claim: The Pillars Consistency Check failure is primarily an external integration-readiness blocker, not an established code defect.
supporting: GitHub App credentials absent
Databricks returned HTTP 403
Hugging Face Space stage BUILD_ERROR
disconfirming_or_alternative: Databricks permission misconfiguration and HF build dependency defects remain possible code/config causes
hypotheses.decision: Keep fail-closed; obtain specific authorized provider diagnostics before changing gates.

red_team_objections: Do not infer that SBI card rewards cause spot XRP purchases; point conversion may use existing inventory.
Do not infer that Circle's ACI pilot displaces XRPL; the announcement explicitly describes multi-rail coexistence.
Do not infer that RLUSD collateral is live on Coinbase Global Exchange; the partnership announcement says this follows later.
Do not infer that Coinbase's x402 standard means Coinbase operates T54's XRPL facilitator.
Do not infer that 1B escrow eligibility means 1B XRP becomes circulating at midnight.
Do not infer that Binance's aggregate reserve change equals the stolen amount or that a company-wide $1.34B acquisition is XRP buying.
Do not infer model skill from the retired 45.5% variable-horizon metric.
Do not infer that SBI's 1.922M accounts or JPY 610B platform deposits are XRP holdings or active XRP demand.
unknowns: Actual SBI XRP reward redemptions, XRP selection share and inventory sourcing.
Production deployment status and volumes of SBI Ripple Asia's XRPL deposit PoC.
Date when SBI VC Trade adds RLUSD on XRPL and whether the 1M JPY limit changes.
Actual Coinbase RLUSD balances, chain-specific deposits/withdrawals, conversion flows and Global Exchange collateral activation.
Circle/ACI pilot live settlement volumes and asset-provider roadmap.
Reconciled x402 cumulative transactions and asset-level settlement value.
Actual EscrowFinish transactions and post-eligibility destinations for the two 500M objects.
Binance same-wallet source-wallet histories and same-time PoR liabilities.
SBI VC Trade's XRP-specific monthly accumulation purchases, card reward credits and B2C2-supported XRP order-book depth.
